question: Should OpenClaw expose `agents.run`, `phase`, and `log` as the permanent core QuickJS Code Mode Swarm API, with restart-persisted replay semantics?
rationale: This is a new user-facing core runtime contract spanning Code Mode, Gateway events, and persisted collector state; code review cannot determine the intended permanent API boundary alone.

options.title: Sponsor the core API after repairs
options.body: Approve the QuickJS Swarm surface as a supported core contract once the compatibility and bridge-budget defects are fixed.

options.title: Narrow the experimental seam
options.body: Keep Swarm experimental but reduce or redesign the guest API before exposing permanent globals and persisted replay behavior.

options.title: Pause the feature contract
options.body: Defer the QuickJS orchestration API until the owning runtime boundary and upgrade contract are explicitly decided.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core API after repairs
recommendation.body: Approve the QuickJS Swarm surface as a supported core contract once the compatibility and bridge-budget defects are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to both the Swarm proposal and the implementation, although a broader current-main ownership review is still needed.
